rationale: The pain of fragmented engineering knowledge is real and recurring, and the HN framing is articulate — but evidence remains thin: a single low-traction post (3 points), no distinct willingness-to-pay signal beyond implicit multi-tool spend, and no competitor pricing data or documented buyer quotes. The minimum bar of 5 distinct pain quotes and at least 1 concrete willingness-to-pay signal (paid workaround, competitor pricing, 'is there a tool' query) is not met from available sources alone, and the solution scope mismatch (narrow intake vs. full context aggregation) adds further risk of buyer disappointment. Marking rejected for this cycle; recommend re-queuing after Market Radar surfaces corroborating threads.
